Porphyry reads 12:1–3 metaphorically of the Maccabean loyalists rising from caves "as if" from the dead; Jerome: bodily resurrection after the Antichrist; time, times and half = 3½ years (Porphyry and Jerome agree on the idiom); the Temple was defiled three years (1 Macc; Josephus), so the 1,290 days belong to the Antichrist; 1,335 = 45 more days before Christ's coming (Porphyry: victory over Antiochus's generals and the cleansing); Theodotion: "you shall rise again in your turn"; the two figures on the banks = angels of the Greeks and Persians
